lumoravoice.widget.voice.description: Connection, microphone, mute state and speaker list
lumoravoice.widget.voice.only_speaking.d: Hides your own HUD during speech pauses.
lumoravoice.widget.voice.speakers.descri: Shows people who are currently speaking.
lumoravoice.widget.voice.heads.descripti: Shows the skin's head in front of the name in the speaker list; a light frame marks who is speaking.
Shows a text next to your own status icon.
lumoravoice.widget.voice.distance.descri: Adds the distance in blocks to the speaker list.
lumoravoice.widget.voice.waves.descripti: Shows the level of speaking people as bars.
lumoravoice.widget.voice.colored_names.d: Uses team colors in the speaker list.
lumoravoice.widget.voice.hide_inactive.d: Only shows people nearby who are speaking.
lumoravoice.widget.voice.block_hint.desc: Shows who is pausing your microphone (blocked player in range).
lumoravoice.widget.voice.max_speakers.de: Maximum number of names shown at once.
lumoravoice.widget.voice.opacity.descrip: Transparency of the status display in game.
lumoravoice.setting.enabled.description: Connects your Minecraft session to Laby Voice or Simple Voice Chat.
lumoravoice.setting.service.description: Automatic: Simple Voice Chat or Plasmo Voice when the server offers it, otherwise Laby Voice.
lumoravoice.setting.muted.description: You keep listening; your microphone sends nothing.
lumoravoice.setting.output_muted.descrip: Your voice is still sent; only playback is muted.
lumoravoice.setting.deafened.description: Turns off receiving and your microphone at once.
lumoravoice.setting.speak_in_menus.descr: Allows the chosen transmission mode while menus are open.
lumoravoice.setting.pause_unfocused.desc: Closes the microphone while Minecraft is in the background.
Short sound when connecting and when your voice state changes.
lumoravoice.setting.microphone.descripti: Choose the recording device from a list.
lumoravoice.setting.alternative_audio.de: Adds OpenAL next to JavaX / JavaSound to the device choice.
lumoravoice.setting.input_backend.descri: Engine used for recording; the device is reset to the system default.
lumoravoice.setting.activation.descripti: Push to talk, automatic voice threshold or always on.
lumoravoice.setting.toggle_ptt.descripti: The first key press starts sending, the next one stops it.
lumoravoice.setting.automatic_gain.descr: Evens out your speaking level. Off: gain from the slider below.
lumoravoice.setting.microphone_gain.desc: Volume of your sent voice and of the microphone test.
lumoravoice.setting.auto_threshold.descr: Measures your background noise and sets the threshold just above it.
lumoravoice.setting.threshold.descriptio: Voice activation only sends above this level.
lumoravoice.setting.release.description: Keeps voice activation open during short pauses.
lumoravoice.setting.noise_gate.descripti: Removes quiet sounds below the gate threshold.
lumoravoice.setting.gate_threshold.descr: Quieter microphone levels are muted while the gate is on.
lumoravoice.setting.high_pass.descriptio: High pass at about 100 Hz against rumble and DC offset.
lumoravoice.setting.noise_suppression.de: RNNoise removes microphone noise locally on your computer.
lumoravoice.setting.microphone_test.desc: You hear yourself with filters and voice compression. Nothing is sent or recorded.
lumoravoice.setting.speaker: Speakers
lumoravoice.setting.speaker.description: Choose the playback device from a list.
lumoravoice.setting.output_backend.descr: Engine used for playback; the device is reset to the system default.
lumoravoice.setting.output_volume.descri: Overall volume of all received voices.
lumoravoice.setting.spatial.description: Normal: left and right follow where you look. Strong: clearer sides, quieter behind you.
lumoravoice.setting.compressor.descripti: Evens out quiet and loud voices of other players.
lumoravoice.setting.ambient.description: Takes water, obstacles and deep caves into account.
lumoravoice.setting.echo.description: Delayed echo for voices below sea level.
lumoravoice.setting.muffle.description: Low pass for voices behind obstacles and under water.
lumoravoice.setting.screamer.description: Reduces peaks that are too loud, after all volume sliders.
lumoravoice.setting.screamer_level.descr: Peaks above this share trigger the protection.
lumoravoice.setting.screamer_max.descrip: Level that triggered peaks are reduced to.
lumoravoice.setting.reopen_devices.descr: Tries again after a device or access error.
lumoravoice.setting.show_hud.description: Shows connection, microphone and mute state in game (key H).
lumoravoice.setting.name_icons.descripti: Speaker right of the name: grey ready, green while speaking.
lumoravoice.setting.tab_icons.descriptio: Shows the voice state next to names in the tab list.
lumoravoice.setting.channel_names.descri: Shows other channels below the player name.
lumoravoice.setting.speech_wave.descript: Live level as a speech bubble above the name.
lumoravoice.setting.hud_editor.descripti: Move and scale it in the Lumora HUD editor.
lumoravoice.setting.focused_volume.descr: Used as soon as at least one person is focused. Focus someone in the player menu (hold the mouse wheel).
lumoravoice.setting.unfocused_volume.des: Lowers other people while your focus is active.
lumoravoice.setting.reset_players.descri: Resets volume, mute and focus of all players. Single players: player menu.
lumoravoice.setting.block_list.descripti: See, remove or add blocked players by name. Players in game: player menu.
lumoravoice.setting.block_pause_mic: Pause microphone while blocked players could listen
lumoravoice.setting.block_pause_mic.desc: Servers send your voice to everyone in range; this way blocked players cannot hear you.
lumoravoice.setting.block_pause_range.de: Sending resumes beyond this distance to a blocked player.
lumoravoice.setting.block_match_names.de: For offline and Bedrock servers where the player's UUID differs.
lumoravoice.setting.channel_list.descrip: See, join, create or leave Laby Voice channels or Simple Voice Chat groups (also with key B).
lumoravoice.setting.channel_activation_o: Uses a separate transmission mode outside of proximity mode.
lumoravoice.setting.channel_activation.d: Push to talk, voice activation or always on in a channel.
lumoravoice.setting.reconnect.descriptio: Tries again after a connection error.
lumoravoice.setting.test_server.descript: Developer service on UDP 8067. Reconnect afterwards.
lumoravoice.setting.reset.description: All LumoraVoice settings and player volumes back to default. The block list stays.
